packageRules.description: Go version: group all Go version updates together to keep them in sync (go.mod; the workflows read it through go-version-file)
Bundle golang.org/x/* updates with Go version bumps so govulncheck sees a consistent set (e.g. golang.org/x/net fixes shipped alongside Go releases)
Go version: automerge minor and patch updates after CI passes
Go version: require manual review for major updates
Go modules: enable updates for indirect dependencies so transitive security patches (e.g. golang.org/x/net via govulncheck) land without waiting for a direct require to bump
Go modules: automerge minor and patch updates after CI passes
Go modules: require manual review for major updates on direct requires

Go modules: never open major PRs for indirect deps. Module-path bumps (/v2 -> /v3) cannot be auto-applied without a direct importer, so go mod tidy resets the indirect line to the MVS minimum and Renovate keeps re-opening the same downgrade PR. Major updates land via the parent direct dependency.
GitHub Actions: automerge minor and patch updates
GitHub Actions: automerge major updates after CI passes
Makefile-pinned Go tools (custom regex manager): automerge minor and patch updates
Makefile-pinned Go tools (custom regex manager): require manual review for major updates
Group Fyne and its own modules (fyne.io/*, github.com/fyne-io/*): the toolkit, its terminal widget and the packaging tool move together

k8s.io/kube-openapi, sigs.k8s.io/structured-merge-diff and sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/* are indirect deps whose compatible version is dictated by the k8s.io/apimachinery release branch, not by their own tip. Renovate's digest updates advanced kube-openapi past the commit where it switched to structured-merge-diff/v7, which apimachinery v0.37.x cannot compile against; kustomize/api and kyaml v0.21.3 require that kube-openapi too (2026-10-12). Let MVS pick them from apimachinery, kubectl and Helm; they still advance whenever the k8s.io/* group does.

github.com/godbus/dbus/v5 v5.2.3 does not compile on macOS and Windows (conn_darwin.go and conn_windows.go: not enough return values; 2026-10-12). Fyne's systray imports it on every platform. Skip that version; a later one is tried as usual.

github.com/fyne-io/terminal is replaced by the patched copy in third_party/fyne-terminal, so bumping its require line changes no code and would only make go.mod name a base the copy is not on. Its update is the signal to move the copy onto that upstream commit (third_party/fyne-terminal/PATCHES.md); never automerge it.
Use 'fix' instead of 'chore' for dependency updates
GitHub Actions: use 'chore' instead of 'fix' for updates

customManagers.description: Update Go tool versions pinned in Makefile via renovate comments. The value may be a release or a Go pseudo-version (vX.Y.Z-0.<time>-<commit>), which semver orders below the next release, so a tool pinned to an upstream commit moves onto that release on its own.
